title: What a Household Has Already Paid Toward Its Snowsports School Tuition
content:
A household that has already settled a good part of its Snowsports School tuition is allowed a reduction in percentage points on the figure collected. The standing is judged as the payments collected on the booking measured against the tuition raised on it, and where no tuition has been raised on the booking there is nothing for the payments to be measured against and no points are allowed on that count.

Where the payments cover half or more of the tuition raised, the settled account points are allowed, and they stand at 5 points. Where they cover at least a quarter of it but less than half, the part settled points are allowed, and they stand at 2 points. Where they cover less than a quarter, no points are allowed, the reduction standing at 0 points.

## What the payments cover, and the points allowed

| Payments collected measured against tuition raised | Points allowed |
| --- | --- |
| half or more | 5 |
| at least a quarter but less than half | 2 |
| less than a quarter | 0 |
| no tuition raised on the booking | 0 |

## Both sides of each boundary, on hypothetical entries

Take a Snowsports School booking on which tuition of 800.00 USD has been raised.

- Payments of 400.00 USD cover exactly half of it, so 5 points are allowed.
- Payments of 399.00 USD cover just under half, so 2 points are allowed.
- Payments of 200.00 USD cover exactly a quarter, so 2 points are allowed.
- Payments of 199.00 USD cover just under a quarter, so no points are allowed.
- Payments of 900.00 USD cover more than the whole of it, so 5 points are allowed.
- Where no tuition entry stands on the booking at all, no points are allowed whatever payments have been collected.

## What the points do

The points are a reduction in percentage points on the figure collected. On a figure of 500.00 USD, 5 points take off 25.00 USD and 2 points take off 10.00 USD.
